name: TERESIA MARIA ANNA (MARIANNA) CICCO
bioAdditions: Teresa Maria Anna was baptized on 29 October 1749, daughter of Bernardo Cicco and Giovanna Moraca (S1). She married Bruno Sacco as 'Marianna' on 29 December 1768 (S2).
